ld2-chile-lifecycle.expected_conclusion: Do not keep the umbrella row as 'Entered into force — 1 February 2025'. That date belongs to the separate EU–Chile Interim Agreement on Trade. The separate Advanced Framework Agreement is partially provisionally applied between the EU and Chile from 1 June 2025 and has not fully entered into force as of 23 September 2026. A safe register either splits the instruments into separate rows or explicitly qualifies the umbrella row with both states.
pass_requires: Recognises at least two distinct legal instruments/lifecycles behind the umbrella label.
Attaches 1 February 2025 to the ITA, not full AFA entry into force.
States AFA partial provisional application from 1 June 2025 and avoids claiming full AFA entry into force.
fail_if: States or implies that the AFA/full modernised agreement entered into force on 1 February 2025.
Collapses ITA and AFA into a single legal instrument/status.

ld2-haringvliet-2015.expected_conclusion: Decision 2015/72's list state omitted Leenheerenpolder from Haringvliet, but a 2026 legal-history note should also state that the Court of Justice in C-281/16 later declared Decision 2015/72 invalid insofar as Haringvliet was listed without Leenheerenpolder. It is misleading to present the exclusion as an unqualified valid EU-law position.
pass_requires: Identifies the later CJEU invalidity judgment C-281/16 or its operative effect.
Separates what the 2015 list displayed from the later validity holding.
fail_if: Presents the 2015 exclusion as an unqualified valid legal position without the later CJEU invalidity.
Treats Decision 2015/72 alone as conclusive for a 2026 legal-history summary.

ld2-shredder-320.expected_conclusion: No. Decision (EU) 2026/80 maintains EN 50434:2014 with a restriction. For machines whose shredding means can rotate at speeds exceeding 300 r/min, the standard does not confer a presumption of conformity with Annex I points 1.1.2(a) and 1.3.3. A 320 r/min machine falls within that restriction.
pass_requires: Finds the current restricted OJ reference status for EN 50434:2014.
Applies the >300 r/min threshold to the 320 r/min machine.
Does not claim presumption for Annex I points 1.1.2(a) and 1.3.3 via that standard.
fail_if: Signs off the YES entry as written for those two points.
Treats harmonised/listed status as an unrestricted presumption for the 320 r/min machine.

ld2-temu-june.expected_conclusion: By 15 June 2024 Temu had been designated a VLOP, and general DSA platform rules already applied, but the additional VLOP-specific Section 5 obligations had not yet reached their post-notification application point. Official Commission material later states the stricter VLOP obligations/risk-assessment requirement applied from 3 October 2024.
pass_requires: Distinguishes general DSA obligations already applicable from the later additional VLOP-specific obligations.
Does not make 31 May designation itself the application start for all VLOP-specific obligations.
fail_if: States that all VLOP-specific/Section 5 obligations applied by 15 June merely because Temu was designated.
States that Temu had no DSA obligations at all on 15 June 2024.

grading.adversarial_pass: All material pass_requires are satisfied in substance and no fail_if event occurs.
grading.control_pass: All material pass_requires are satisfied in substance and no fail_if event occurs.
